pages.text: Thrown like a snowball; on impact builds a Supreme Furnace at the landing spot. Three tiers: $(item)T1$() builds 32³, $(item)T2$() builds 64³, $(item)T3$() builds 128³. The landing block becomes the bottom-center of the new structure.

pages.title: Warning
pages.text: $(thing)Destroys and voids$() every block inside the target cube — including chests, spawners, and anything else in the way — without dropping anything. Use over open ground or somewhere you don't mind losing.
